title: Director of Data and AI
summary: A director of data and AI leads data science, data engineering and analytics for a company or business unit. They choose which data and AI projects to fund, set standards for models and data quality, oversee the data platform and lead several team managers. They report to the CTO, CDO or Head of AI.
dailyDuties: Agree data and AI priorities with business heads
Review model results and launch decisions
Set data quality, governance and MLOps standards
Oversee the data platform roadmap and cost
Lead and hire data science and engineering managers
Report outcomes and value to leadership

skills.expectation: Pick and fund data and AI use cases with business leaders
Guide model approach and review results
Set standards to deploy and monitor models
Own data quality, lineage and access rules
Lead data science, data engineering and analytics managers
Work with business heads on outcomes
Apply responsible AI and model risk rules
Report value from data and AI to leadership

certifications.why: Useful for leaders still close to ML delivery.
